overall_judgement: Emerging GreenComp integration: a useful sustainability entry point, but the unit mainly teaches facts and prescribed behaviours.

strengths.evidence: Explicit sustainability theme connected to school life
Group work, multilingual support and European examples
Intention to connect learning with practical action
strengths.reason: Can be developed into an authentic action cycle.

findings.required_detection: Awareness and greener choices are generic and behaviour-focused; connected impacts, fairness and human-nature relationships are not observable.
findings.expected_direction: Reframe the unit as investigation of a local challenge, connected impacts, values and one feasible improvement.

findings.required_detection: Outcomes mainly measure recall and task completion.
findings.expected_direction: Add observable problem framing, systems mapping, source judgement, future options, collective action and reflection outcomes.

findings.required_detection: The teacher selects the problem, sources, roles and actions; pupils follow instructions.
findings.expected_direction: Keep teacher-set safety and learning boundaries while giving pupils bounded choices over questions, roles, evidence, options and action.

findings.required_detection: The checklist observes isolated objects but not causes, actors, routines, rules, natural resources or consequences.
findings.expected_direction: Collect simple baseline data, create a systems map and revise a problem statement.

findings.required_detection: European examples are recorded as facts without source evaluation, context, missing perspectives, future scenarios or option comparison.
findings.expected_direction: Compare evidence and contexts, identify missing voices, imagine plausible/preferred futures and select among alternatives using impact, fairness and feasibility criteria.

findings.required_detection: The clean-up is predetermined and the poster is not linked to a decision route, evidence of effect or adaptation.
findings.expected_direction: Present an evidence-based proposal to an appropriate stakeholder, agree a feasible pilot, act, gather feedback or before/after evidence and reflect on influence and limits.

findings.required_detection: Assessment rewards attention, recall, neatness and presentation more than GreenComp reasoning and agency.
findings.expected_direction: Assess inquiry/systems, evidence/perspectives, alternatives/decision, collective action and reflection/adaptation. Keep the quiz formative.

findings.required_detection: A fixed poster hides the process and review is teacher-only.
findings.expected_direction: Use a flexible Green Action Portfolio with common evidence components and a joint pupil-teacher review cycle.

automatic_fail_conditions: Generic advice without an exact input location
Any runtime transmission of the input document
Automatic rewriting without teacher decision controls
